answer: Give every account an onyx seal: a one-way commitment binding a deposit to one behavioral fingerprint, so one operator cannot mint a second seal without paying again. Then rotate beacon duty: each account periodically emits an unpredictable prompt that neighbours must mirror back with original, time-stamped work in a short window. One person can mirror one beacon honestly, but a farm of clones cannot mirror many beacons at once without identical timing, copied phrasing, or missed windows. Mirrors are scored for divergence; accounts whose mirrors converge closely lose seal and deposit.
